results.title: 401(k) limit 2027: Still Not Announced — $25,500 Is a Projection
results.content:
The 401(k) limit 2027 is still not announced. The IRS has set almost every 2027 tax number — the brackets, the standard deduction, the credits — but the one retirement savers keep asking about is still missing. As of today, Tuesday, November 10, 2026, the IRS has not published the 2027 limits for 401(k), 403(b), 457 and IRA accounts. That means every 2027 figure you see quoted online right now is a forecast, not a rule you can plan a payroll election on.

...

The limits that still govern are the 2026 ones, from IRS Notice 2025-67, announced November 13, 2025. The employee deferral limit for a 401(k), 403(b), governmental 457 plan or Thrift Savings Plan is $24,500. The IRA limit is $7,500. The age-50 catch-up is $8,000, the ages 60–63 super catch-up is $11,250, and the total limit from all sources into a 401(k) is $72,000. For context on how last year’s limits were set, see our coverage of the 2026 tax brackets and standard deduction.

...

It puts the 2027 employee deferral limit at $25,500, up $1,000 from $24,500, with the age-50 catch-up rising to $8,500 and the ages 60–63 super catch-up to $11,750.

results.title: 2027 401(k) and IRA Limits: Not Out Yet, What to Expect
results.content:
The IRS has not announced the 2027 401(k) or IRA contribution limits yet. As of October 30, 2026, the official limits are still the 2026 ones: $24,500 for a 401(k) and $7,500 for an IRA. Last year the IRS published the next year's limits on November 13, so the 2027 numbers will probably come in November.

...

The IRS’s cost-of-living adjustments page currently shows 2026 as the latest year, with no 2027 figures. The 2026 limits come from the IRS news release of November 13, 2025 and Notice 2025-67:

results.title: 2027 Retirement Limits, Social Security and Medicare
results.content:
The 2027 retirement plan limits are not out yet. As of November 6, 2026 the IRS has not issued its 2027 notice for 401(k), IRA and charitable-distribution limits, and CMS has not posted the 2027 Medicare Part B premium or its income-related surcharges (IRMAA). Other 2027 amounts are published. This page keeps the two groups apart, adds cross-border Social Security and pension points, and closes with the Pending-Notice Pinboard.

When will the IRS publish the 2027 401(k) and IRA limits?

No date is promised. Last year's Notice 2025-67 came November 13, 2025. Numbers circulating now are projections, not IRS figures.

results.title: When Will the IRS Announce 2027 401(k) Limits? A Timeline | SuperCatchUp Planner
results.content:
As of 2026-09-12, the IRS has not published 2027 401(k)/403(b) limits. The current 2026 elective deferral limit is $24,500. Historically, the following year's figures are published in a November IRS notice — the 2026 figures came from Notice 2025-67 (IRB 2025-49). This page states no 2027 dollar figures; check the IRS COLA page directly once the notice is out.
